verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA H200 is a data-center GPU accelerator. User-defined event-triggered automation rules are a workflow or SaaS capability outside this product category. The evidence shows no first-party rules engine for the GPU; cuML/cuDF automatic CPU fallback is built-in routing, not user-defined rules triggered by events.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
